identity.name: Pipistrel Virus SW 121A Explorer (the outside master of the Virus / Velis Electro pair)
identity.engine: Rotax 912 S3-01, 73.5 kW / 5800 rpm (5 min), MCP 69 kW / 5500; MT-Propeller MTV-33-1-A/170-200, 2 blades, 1700 mm, constant speed, clockwise
notes: One airframe, two cards (the user, 16 Nov): the outside is fitted ONCE to this sheet, then the Velis Electro (SW 128) card is generated from it. TCDS section B: 6.47 m long, 2.06 m high, same span and wing; 3-blade fixed-pitch P-812-164-F3A 1640 mm; E-811 57.6 kW (90 s) / 49.2 kW MCP; 2 x 11.0 kWh liquid-cooled batteries (front: behind the motor and firewall; rear: in the Explorer baggage bay behind the cabin, POH-128 p.14 cutaway); no wheel fairings, no exhaust, no airbrakes.
The base SW 121 is 6.40 m long (TCDS section A); the Explorer (section D) 6.42 m: the POH and the sheet are the Explorer.
The two POHs give different tail areas for the same spans (Explorer HT 1.39 / fin 1.24 m2; Velis 1.02 / 0.86 m2): different definitions, unexplained. Spans and heights are used, areas not.
